page_title: HAV 0-2 LIL | Le Havre v Lille 01/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+3' Here is a change. Edon Zhegrova (Lille) is going off and Paulo Fonseca gives the last tactical orders to Aaron Malouda.
90+3' Substitution. Ignacio Miramon replaces Angel Gomes (Lille).
90+1' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Le Havre comes to nothing.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) got the ball on the edge of the box and fired in a first-time shot on goal, but his effort floated well over the bar. High, wide and not at all handsome.
86' Paulo Fonseca has decided to substitute Ivan Cavaleiro and he is replaced by Alan Virginius (Lille).
84' A substitution has been made. Abdoulaye Toure goes off and Loic Nego (Le Havre) comes on.
84' Le Havre take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
79' The current number of shots on goal is 0:6. We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 5:13.
77' Substitution. Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Remy Cabella walks off.
75' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lille.

72' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the penalty spot wasn't accurate enough and the ball went a few inches wide of the left post.
71' Luka Elsner decides to make a substitution. Rassoul Ndiaye will be replaced by Yassine Kechta (Le Havre).
70' The manager makes a subsitution with Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) coming on for Josue Casimir.
66' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lille comes to nothing.
64' The ball is behind the sideline. Christopher Operi (Le Havre) takes a throw-in.
61' Luka Elsner has decided to make a change. Samuel Grandsir (Le Havre) replaces Nabil Alioui.
61' Substitution. Andy Logbo (Le Havre) in, Issa Soumare out.
59' Bafode Diakite (Lille) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
58' Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
53' Le Havre control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
52' An unfortunate own goal is conceded by Yoann Salmier (Le Havre), who attempted to block the ball after a cross, but instead he sends it into the middle of his own goal and behind the goalkeeper.
52' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
49' Nabil Alioui (Le Havre) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
48' Le Havre can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
48' Substitution. Edon Zhegrova walks off the pitch and Aaron Malouda (Lille) comes on as a substitute.
48' Substitution. Angel Gomes makes way for Ignacio Miramon (Lille).
47' Yoann Salmier (Le Havre) commits a rough challenge and Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

45+2' He should have scored! Jonathan David (Lille) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the bottom left corner is pretty weak and Arthur Desmas makes an easy save.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.

40' 0 - 1 Goal! Edon Zhegrova (Lille) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the top left corner. Arthur Desmas had no chance of reaching it. The score is 0:1.
37' Alexsandro (Lille) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
36' Lille are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
33' The resulting set piece from Lille is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
33' Half-chance! Edon Zhegrova (Lille) plays a pass into the box, but Arthur Desmas reacts well to snuff out the attack. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Lille.
30' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lille.
29' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
29' Lille failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
27' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Le Havre, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
25' The corner is swung in but Le Havre can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
24' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) volleys the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but one of the defenders blocks his shot.
23' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Christopher Operi (Le Havre).
20' Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) sends a long ball in, but Lucas Chevalier comfortably gathers the ball.
18' Le Havre have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
16' The Le Havre players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
12' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Arthur Desmas scrambling, but it flies just wide of the left post.
10' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!
7' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Josue Casimir (Le Havre) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
5' The free kick from long range, taken by Le Havre, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
5' Lille take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Lille will have the kick-off.
Bastien Dechepy got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
